author: Bee (Shel)
title: Writer hiring fantasy character/concept artists (paid)
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I’m a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I’m looking for artists to help bring it to life! I’m starting small, but this is paid work. I’m looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Follow-up (still open): overwhelmed by responses, still early and figuring out funding/budgeting, will post more about the show. Contact: reply on the Threads post with work + rates, or DM @bee.chaoticcore.

author: blekek.k
title: Hiring illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (still reviewing): surprised by interest, checking portfolios; people who have not sent a portfolio can provide a link to previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.
